clips.title: The story
paras: The Sacred Flame is a Horde task initiated by Zangen Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff. Seeking to recover an ancient relic guarded by the Galak centaur in Thousand Needles, Zangen sends adventurers deep into Ashenvale to acquire a sacred moonwell phial from the local dryads.

The Galak tribe of centaur inhabiting the canyon floor of Thousand Needles fiercely protects an artifact dating back to the creation of their race. To pierce their defenses and extinguish their sacred flames, Zangen Stonehoof requires water touched by lunar divinity, drawing the tauren's gaze northward to the ancestral forests of Ashenvale.

Obtaining pure moonwell water is no simple task. Unblessed vessels cannot hold the sacred liquid without corrupting its virtue, forcing Horde emissaries to hunt the Laughing Sisters near Raynewood Retreat to secure an etched phial. Once retrieved, the phial must be submerged into a moonwell along the western banks of the Falfarren River before being carried back to Mulgore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.
We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
